final: WITH film_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS inventory_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(inventory_count) AS rating_avg FROM film_counts GROUP BY rating), deviations AS (SELECT fc.film_id, fc.rating, fc.inventory_count, fc.inventory_count - ra.rating_avg AS deviation FROM film_counts AS fc JOIN rating_averages AS ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(inventory_count) AS avg_count FROM deviations) SELECT d.film_id, d.rating, d.inventory_count, d.deviation, d.deviation - oa.avg_count FROM deviations AS d CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oa.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.deviation - oa.avg_count DESC LIMIT 10
